newsitem.title: USA: Starwood sweetens California Jockey offer.
newsitem.headline: Starwood sweetens California Jockey offer.

text.p: Starwood Capital Group LLC, a private real estate investment firm, on Tuesday proposed to acquire California Jockey Club and Bay Meadows Operating Co for $22 a share, revising an earlier offer.

The proposed deal, which includes an investment by Starwood of up to $300 million, would provide the shareholders of California Jockey with the right to tender their stock for $22 a share or to participate with Starwood in the recapitalized company, Starwood said.

Starwood's earlier proposal, which was not previously made public, was essentially the same as the revised one, except the price was $21 per share instead of the current $22, a company spokesman said.
